notes: §1985:XII.2.4 GR9: an unreplaced library word starts in the area it begins in within the library; "Each text word in pseudo-text-2 that is to be placed into the resultant program begins in the same area of the resultant program as it appears in pseudo-text-2"; identifier-2, literal-2 and word-2 begin in the area of the leftmost replaced word; introduced words are on debugging lines as the rule's third paragraph says; a too-long literal is continued, and one that must be continued on a debugging line is an error. The debugging and literal arms conform (p9f, p7a, p11a, p11c, COBOL7039 p11b; witness 1985-GR-XII_2_4-11, p10a), the unreplaced arm (witness 1985-GR-XII_2_4-9; p9e) and the word-2 arm (p9ii, p9iv). The pseudo-text-2 arm conforms since kb/Work PB5313 (landed): ApplyReplacements writes pseudo-text-2 with OriginWriter.AppendLaidOut, so each word stands at the replaced word (its origin) and is laid out where pseudo-text-2 wrote it, and AreaPlacementPass judges whether it begins its resultant line from the token stream and its area at the laid-out place (p9v, p9iii accepted: witness pb5313-copy-pseudo-text-area-a; p9i refused COBOL3734: pb5313-copy-pseudo-text-area-b). The third paragraph's "only those text words that are specified on debugging lines where the debugging line is within pseudo-text-2 appear on debugging lines" holds for identifier-2 since kb/Work PB5471 (landed; pb5471-identifier-2-over-debugging-line). Also observed, root outside COPY: p9d2 (no COPY) refuses a paragraph-name beginning in column 11 after X. ("follows other text of its line"), so GR9's second sentence's case of two words in area A of one line cannot arise.

next.reason: Amendment 1 (X3.23a-1989) completed the third paragraph's cut sentence: 'When a text word specified in the BY phrase is introduced, it appears on a debugging line if the first library text word being replaced is specified on a debugging line' (§1985:XII.2.4 GR9); that adds one more debugging-line placement case and no 2023 rule carries any of them, 2023 having no debugging lines. The subject, where copied and replacement text words go in the resultant text, has a different requirement. 1985: each word 'is copied so as to start in the same area of the line in the resultant program as it begins in the line within the library', identifier-2, literal-2 and word-2 begin 'in the same area' as the matched word, and for a long literal 'additional continuation lines are introduced which contain the remainder of the literal'. §2023:7.2.3.4 GR11 instead: 'The resultant text after replacement shall be in logical free-form reference format', where 'additional spaces may be introduced only between text-words where there already exists a space or at the end of a source line'; there are no area A/B or continuation rules for the result. 'Library text must conform to the rules for COBOL reference format' survives as §2023:6.1 GR1 b) 'A COBOL compiler shall accept source text and library text written in reference format'.
